name: uptimelens
description: ## The Problem Most small teams and solo developers run servers without real visibility into their health.  A container can silently crash, disk space can quietly fill up, or a deploy can fail — and  nobody finds out until users complain. Enterprise tools like Datadog or New Relic solve this,  but they're expensive and often overkill for a single server or small project — so many  self-hosted setups end up running blind.
